title: Awareness on Spotting Signs of Abuse in Schools
what_it_is: Awareness on Spotting Signs of Abuse in Schools

sections.label: Student personal safety and abuse reporting
sections.summary: Students learn personal safety through Character and Citizenship Education, with peer support structures and MSF screening and reporting guides introduced in 2015.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Education (Ms Gan Siow Huang) (for the Minister for Education )
sentences.text: Our students learn about personal safety and how they can protect themselves against abuse through Character and Citizenship Education lessons.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Education (Ms Gan Siow Huang) (for the Minister for Education )
sentences.text: Students are provided with resources and community helplines and are reminded to seek help from trusted adults when their personal safety is compromised.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Education (Ms Gan Siow Huang) (for the Minister for Education )
sentences.text: Schools have also instituted peer support structures where students are taught to look out for one another and to inform trusted adults when they observe that their peers are under distress.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Education (Ms Gan Siow Huang) (for the Minister for Education )
sentences.text: The Ministry for Social and Family Development (MSF) has introduced the Sector-Specific Screening Guide (SSSG) and the Child Abuse Reporting Guide (CARG) in 2015 to help schools manage abuse-related issues.
